meta.title: Reverse auction: the vendor tries to bid again after revoking
warnings: resolved: “Revoke Vendor A's previous bid in the vendor portal before attempting the replacement bid.” — switch_portal / vendor_open_event open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor in a second browser

steps.note: Open the existing prepared event without creating or searching for another event.
Continue in the invited vendor's separate supplier-portal session.
Open the live auction's pricing bid sheet as Vendor A.

args.need: revoke Vendor A's previous bid in the vendor portal and leave the event ready for a new bid attempt

steps.note: The catalog has no vendor-side revoke action, so the tester must establish the required revoked state.

args.because: You cannot place a bid after revoking the previous one

steps.note: Attempt the replacement bid and verify that Procol refuses it with the expected revocation message.
